title: Sand Between Pines | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ascend through the home's levels, and you'll discover well-appointed bedrooms, including a serene master suite with a private balcony and a sitting area that offers breathtaking lake views. The custom kitchen is a culinary dream, equipped with high-end appliances and a spacious island, while the adjacent screened-in porch provides a tranquil setting for dining al fresco. The third floor presents a cozy lounge area perfect for unwinding, and the journey culminates on the fourth floor, where a spiral staircase leads to a tower showcasing unrivaled vistas of the surrounding WaterColor community. Outside, the summer kitchen and screened porch set the stage for memorable family gatherings, enhanced by the lush backdrop and the gentle lapping of lake waters—a truly exquisite setting for a luxurious beach vacation. Sand Between Pines is a resplendent retreat nestled in the serene Lake District of WaterColor, flaunting panoramic views of Western Lake. This majestic vacation rental harmoniously blends luxury with coastal charm across its expansive layout, featuring five bedrooms plus additional bunk space. Each space within the home has been thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort and elegance, from the plush private pool and spa to the inviting outdoor living area—ideal for families seeking both relaxation and entertainment. The property’s open-concept design features pristine white oak flooring that seamlessly connects the living room to a state-of-the-art kitchen, accentuating the airy, coastal-inspired decor.
